name: Wolves Dinner
source:
You come home after a long day at work throwing yourself on the bed feeling exhausted but after a while, you decide to roam around your room finding something to do. You stumbled upon some fliers in your desk drawer but one catches your eye, it's about a new cafe in town. You gave the cafe a visit, then sh*t kinda goes wrong and you end up in the cafes owner's basement.

[From [url=https://trash-eater-games.itch.io/wolvesdinner]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
经过一整天的工作后，你回到家，躺在床上，感觉筋疲力尽，但过了一会儿，你决定在房间里闲逛，找点事做。你在办公桌抽屉里偶然发现了一些传单，但其中一张引起了你的注意，这是关于镇上一家新咖啡馆的。你参观了咖啡馆，然后出了点问题，你最终来到了咖啡馆老板的地下室。

[来自[url=https://trash-eater-games.itch.io/wolvesdinner]Itch.io[/url]]
